text:
Emmitt Finnie was the 201st pick in 2023. In his second NHL season he is playing more than 19 minutes a night for Detroit, about two and a half more than earlier in the season, and Prashanth Iyer of Expected By Whom wrote that Detroit has "finally found their 1C", adding in another post that it was "only the slightest of hyperbole".

The production is real enough: 11 points in 18 games, 7 goals, after 30 points in all 82 games as a rookie. He is shooting 18.4%, so the goal pace should cool, and the Wings have scored 4 more goals than expected with him on the ice.

What is not luck is his skating. NHL EDGE has him at 80 bursts over 20 mph, in the league's top percentile, and 94th percentile in top speed. At five on five Detroit takes 57% of expected goals with him on. With the team losing four of its last five, we'd watch whether a 21-year-old can keep that share against harder matchups.
headline: Finnie, a seventh-round pick, is now a top-line forward
